entry.title: AdultHideout 1.0.27 Quicksilver
entry.summary: Quicksilver runs Global Search and Mega Shuffle natively in AdultHideout Core: all 300+ sources in a single concurrent pass, 20% more results in 25% less time, cleaner results, a streamlined network layer, a fresh Core for all seven platforms and 27 refreshed websites.

entry.title: AdultHideout 1.0.26 Core Horizon
entry.summary: Core Horizon introduces the Dual-Engine Hybrid Architecture with the native Rust AdultHideout Core service and automatic classic Python fallback, concurrent 302-source Global Search and Mega Shuffle, on-demand ~3 MB platform binary delivery, local HLS/MP4 stream relaying, 5-language localization, and repairs across 37 websites.
